Build Your Own SKILL.md
STEP 1 · WRITE
A skill is a written playbook the AI loads only when a task calls for it
weekly-report/SKILL.md
--- name: weekly-report description: Use when asked   for the weekly report ---
WHEN
# Weekly Report ## Inputs ## Steps ## Rules ## Output format
HOW
Optional extras: examples, templates, scripts
BUILD IT IN FOUR MOVES
Pick a task you repeat
Write the description
Write the steps, rules and output
Test it on real inputs
Pick a task you repeat
Same steps every week? That's a skill.
Write the description
It decides when the skill kicks in.
Write the steps, rules and output
Brief it the way you'd brief a new intern.
Test it on real inputs
Fix the SKILL.md, then run it again.
2
A Real Skill: LinkedIn Research
WORKED EXAMPLE
A contact list goes in; a classified spreadsheet comes out, with checks at every step
Read the list
Check the login
Work in batches
Find and verify
Classify
Build the Excel
Read the list
CSV or Excel; spot the search-term columns
Check the login
The user signs in; the skill never touches passwords
Work in batches
25 at a time, one profile at a time, progress saved
Find and verify
Rate each match: High, Medium, Needs review, Not found
Classify
Apply the user's rules, with a one-line reason each
Build the Excel
Sheets: Results, Needs Review, Summary
WHY IT'S RELIABLE
Stops at CAPTCHAs
Flags, never guesses
Resumes, never restarts
Rules in one block

Creating Testing Agents
STEP 2 · TEST
Don't grade your own homework: a second agent checks the first one's output
Builder agent
Tester agent
Output
Fail: send fix list
Pass: deliver
Loop until it passes, or hand it to a person after three tries
WHAT THE TESTER CHECKS
Format
Facts
Rules
Edge cases
Format
Right columns, sheets and file name?
Facts
Does every claim trace back to a source?
Rules
Was each rule applied, with a valid reason?
Edge cases
Blanks, duplicates, missing names?

Stop and snapshot

2
Trace the root cause

3
Fix it upstream
Change the brief or SKILL.md, not just this one output.
4
Re-run and re-test
Run again from that step, and add the issue to the tester's checklist.
